description: A kind, motherly woman in her fifties with a warm, slightly low, smooth voice, speaking Greek as her native language with a standard Athenian Greek accent. Calm, peaceful and heartfelt, like leading a prayer in a quiet church, with natural human rhythm and phrasing at a normal speaking speed.
ref_text: Δόξα Πατρί και Υιώ και Αγίω Πνεύματι, και νυν και αεί και εις τους αιώνας των αιώνων. Αμήν.
